entity.description.vehicle_top_speed: The fastest it drives without boost.
entity.description.vehicle_power: Engine horsepower. More gets it up to speed faster and up steeper hills.
entity.description.vehicle_grip: Tyre friction on all four wheels. Lower slides and drifts more, higher sticks to the road.
entity.description.vehicle_steering: How far the front wheels turn at low speed, in degrees.
entity.description.vehicle_fast_steering: How far the front wheels turn at speed, in degrees. Lower is more stable.
entity.description.vehicle_drive_bias: How the engine's power is split between the axles: 0 is front wheel drive, 1 is rear wheel drive, in between is all wheel drive.
entity.description.on: Whether the light is switched on.
entity.description.radius: The radius affected by the light.
entity.description.attenuation: How quickly the light fades with distance.
entity.description.temperature: The color temperature of the light. Lower is warmer, higher is cooler, 6500 is neutral white.
entity.description.animated: Whether the light's brightness is animated.
entity.description.animationoffset: Shifts the animation in time, so identical lights don't play in step.
entity.description.turnon: The input that switches the light on.
entity.description.turnoff: The input that switches the light off.
entity.description.toggle: The input that toggles the light.
entity.description.angle: The outer angle of the spotlight cone.
entity.description.castshadows: Whether the light's model casts shadows, or only its shadow is drawn.
entity.description.tv_brightness: The brightness of the television screen.
entity.description.tv_on: Whether the television screen is switched on.
entity.description.dynamite_damage: The damage dealt by the explosion.
entity.description.dynamite_radius: The radius affected by the explosion.
entity.description.dynamite_force: The strength of the explosion's physical force.
entity.description.dynamite_activate: The input that detonates the explosive.
entity.description.emitter: The effect spawned by this emitter.
entity.description.mode: Toggle with each press, or emit only while the input is held.
entity.description.toggleinput: The input that toggles the emitter.
entity.description.holdinput: The input held to keep emitting.
entity.description.manualon: Force the emitter on regardless of its input or mode.
entity.name.speaker: Speaker
entity.description.camera_tracking_speed: How quickly the camera's aim follows its target. Lower values are smoother; higher values respond faster. Target changes are blended smoothly.
entity.description.camera_tracking_range: Maximum target distance in game units (inches). Applies to Owner as well as nearest-target modes. Dead or disabled targets are ignored.
entity.description.camera_tracking_retur: When no valid target is in range, smoothly return to the lens's original aim. Disable to hold the last tracked direction instead.
entity.description.camera_tracking_offse: Aim this far from the target, in world units (inches). Raise Z to aim above a player's head.
entity.description.camera_tracking_zoom: Narrow the field of view so the target fills the frame, easing at the Lerp Speed. Without a target it eases back to the camera's FOV.
entity.description.camera_tracking_zoom_: Degrees added to the fitted field of view. Positive zooms out to show more around the target, negative zooms in closer.
entity.description.camera: A physical camera with a configurable view binding and TV feed. Cannot be collected as a weapon.
entity.description.speaker_retrigger: When a one-shot is triggered again: restart it, ignore the trigger while busy, overlap another voice, or queue it until playback finishes. Queue holds up to 32 waiting sounds; Stop Sounds clears them.
entity.description.speaker_max_voices: Maximum overlapping one-shots. At the limit, the oldest voice is stopped to make room for the newest.
entity.description.speaker_sound: The sound played by the key or trigger. Any sound in the game, or one from the workshop.
entity.description.speaker_mode: Play once per press, play while held, or toggle on and off with each press.
entity.description.speaker_looping: In Hold or Toggle mode, start the sound again whenever it ends, for as long as it's on.
entity.description.speaker_volume: How loud the speaker is. Can be wired.
entity.description.speaker_pitch: Playback speed, 1 is normal. Can be wired.
entity.description.speaker_key: The key that plays the sound from a seat on this contraption.
entity.description.speaker_range: Maximum direct-sound distance. Volume reaches zero at this range. 1 inch = 1 game unit.
entity.description.speaker_falloff: How quickly volume fades with distance: 1 is linear, lower values keep it louder farther away, and higher values fade faster.
entity.description.spawninput: The input that spawns an entity.
entity.description.autospawn: Spawn entities automatically at the configured interval.
entity.description.maxentities: The maximum number of spawned entities allowed to exist at once.
entity.description.npc_health: Current health. The NPC dies when this drops below 1.
entity.description.npc_friendly: Follow players and attack hostile NPCs instead of targeting players.
entity.description.npc_engagespeed: Movement speed while engaging an enemy.
